invalid.because: Not a convention for these scripts here; poor reading.
Light on dark is not paper ink.

limits.scale: Forms snap to module multiples; dominant form 2-8 modules; type from the modular scale.
limits.safe: Type block in its layout slot, which forms may never enter (hard exclusion mask); 6% outer margin.
limits.colour: Max 3 inks; type always the darkest ink (or paper on negative).
limits.motion: Max 4 steps per second per form; all steps share the trigger source.
limits.material: Riso grain only on uncoated paper systems; negative print has no paper texture.
